Claim amendment to this seat's claim 6868398958 on #33179 · 2026-11-14T00:33Z: the file surface adds, for one pure per-request memo only,
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`: a private memo of the delegator resolution, kept per live context object and keyed and retired exactly like the existing permission-set memo (the write epoch, plus a key of the delegator id, the tenant and the org peer set);
- `security-plugin-object-admission.ts` and `security-plugin-field-readers.ts`: the two schema-read call sites switch to that memo. They only read the resolved delegator context.
- their tests, and `@objectstack/plugin-security` added to the changeset at patch.

Why: measured at `origin/main` 68972cd2 (`out/33179-measure.md`), a caller acting on behalf of a person (the OAuth MCP door) sends 26 more SELECTs for each listed object, 2 security calls × 13 delegator reads. Callers that act for themselves send a constant count. The MCP bridge cannot remove these reads, because the security API answers one object at a time.

Bounds the seat set for this amendment:
- Nothing outlives the context object or any write. The other seven delegator call sites are unchanged.
- Every answer stays the same for every caller, including the delegated caller. The answer-identity golden covers that caller.
- Clause-② stays `no`.
